title: JIRA REST does not return errors on transitioning an issue
description: The outcome of the transition is ignored, and all we get back is an empty 204 response.    REST:      This code is taken from: https://atlaseye.atlassian.com/browse/jira-rest/jira-rest-plugin/src/main/java/com/atlassian/jira/rest/v2/issue/UpdateIssueResource.java?r=8c7d68606c899d4f781431ddfda4fd9ee499120a      Action (called from JIRA UI):      This means that FishEye / Stash cannot detect when things go wrong when transitioning an issue.    Additionally, the response we get back even in the success case is empty. It would be very nice to be given the expandable issue object so that we dont need a second request to get the new state + transitions.    We will be implementing the following workaround:  * make the transition  * re-retrieve the issue  * check that the """"to state"""" of the transition is equal to the new state of the issue  * if it is not, display a generic error message that something went wrong in JIRA    Is there anything wrong with this workaround?

title: Document that Issue Collector does not support all fields
description: {panel:bgColor=#e7f4fa}   *NOTE:* This suggestion is for *JIRA Server*. Using *JIRA Cloud*? [See the corresponding suggestion|http://jira.atlassian.com/browse/JRACLOUD-33954].   {panel}  It would be useful to list somewhere the fields that are not supported for custom Issue Collectors. I know from the advanced usage that some custom fields can be added using custom JavaScript and I assume that fields such as """"Due Date"""" can also be added, but I'm not sure.    Please also see the discussion on this at https://answers.atlassian.com/questions/79461/issue-adding-custom-fields-to-issue-collector-template    To reproduce:    # Added Due Date and Linked Issues to the Default screen.  # Checked that Due Date and Linked Issues were not hidden in the field configuration  # Checked Permission Scheme: Allowed 'Anyone' to Schedule Issues, Allowed 'Anyone' to Link Issues  # Went to create an issue collector   Made issue collector for my TEST project  Chose to collect issues as Bugs   choose Custom for Issue Template Form     Result - The Due Date and Linked Issues fields are not available in the custom form
